events.evidence: A series of bombings across Iraq, including Baghdad, Hillah and Kirkuk, kills at least 93 people and wounds over 300 others
Greeks withdraw their cash from banks and stock up on non-perishable food ahead of Sunday's election
The Syrian government begins printing money for the first time in a sign that the Syrian economy is on the verge of total collapse

label.note: Greek election bank withdrawals and Syrian economic collapse dominate; Iraq bombings add geopolitical risk.
